annotations.title: MCP tool pin check: has an approved tool changed?

description: MCP tool pin check: has an approved tool changed?. Use when an agent or operator approved an MCP server's tools and needs to know, before calling them again, whether any tool definition changed, was removed or was added since, compared with PageVerified's signed record of the server's tool list. Cost: 1 credit per call.

pins.description: Tool name to SHA-256, as returned in tool_hashes by an earlier call. Up to 200. Omit it to get the current hashes to pin.

since.description: ISO 8601 date: report whether the tool list changed after it (slug lookups only).

slug.description: The PageVerified directory slug (from /t/<slug>). Adds last-checked time and changed_since.

url.description: The MCP endpoint URL, exactly as PageVerified's directory tracks it. Supply url or slug.

name: tool_pin_check
